newsitem.title: USA: Boston Edison sees nuke power boost Monday.
newsitem.headline: Boston Edison sees nuke power boost Monday.

text.p: Boston Edison Co expects to boost output at its 670 megawatt Pilgrim nuclear power plant later Monday after cutting production over the weekend for a power suppression test, a company spokesman said.
"We should be done with the testing by the end of the day and, depending on the outcome...should be able to increase power later today," spokesman David Tarantino said Monday.

The unit, located at Plymouth, Mass., was holding at 66 percent power Monday during the testing, Tarantino said. Power could be reduced further if testing finds a leak in a control rod, Tarantino said.
